question: Do the four officer-derived columns (NEO_COUNT, NEO_TURNOVER, CEO_DUALITY, CEO_TENURE) improve the equities MTNN?
verdict: NO METRIC EXCEEDS THE SEED NOISE FLOOR. The only sign-consistent signal is CQS, positive at all three paired seeds (+0.0032/+0.0025/+0.0050, mean +0.0036) while every other metric is mixed-sign. Three of three under a null is p=0.125 — suggestive, not significant. The honest reading is that these four columns do not measurably improve the model.
design: Identical config and seed in both arms; ONLY train_matrix.npz differs. ARM A is the pre-fill matrix from git HEAD~1 (54.5% observed, 33 zero-coverage columns); ARM B is post-fill (57.0%, 29). Three seeds per arm, because a single pair cannot separate a real gain from seed noise.
control_validated: A_prefill seed 7 reproduced the shipped model exactly — recall 0.910, purity 0.4855, sector 0.5454, r2 0.1965, CQS 0.6154 — so the trainer is deterministic at fixed seed and arm A is a valid control rather than an approximation of one.
noise_floor_rule: The within-arm seed range is the noise floor. A between-arm difference smaller than the larger arm's own spread is not distinguishable from which seed happened to run.
limitation: THREE SEEDS IS THIN. It establishes that the effect is not large; it cannot rule out a real effect of roughly the size observed. Ruling that in or out needs more seeds, which is a cost decision, not a finding.
